The CLI currently takes config as a positional argument and makes the ingestion key optional. I’ll change it to `data members fetch <INGESTION_KEY> --config <PATH>`, apply the same pattern to member loading and declaration fetching, and use `--config` for `data latest`.

Worktree: `/Users/jamie/development/exposed-cli-ingestion-arguments-20261005`  
Branch: `refactor/cli-ingestion-arguments-20261005`

The change fits within the CLI adapter: Clap will require a UUID ingestion key and a config option before any command runs. I’m also updating the examples and adding parser coverage. I’m using the Simplified Technical English skill for the documentation text.
